entities.name: Lavabrink
entities.description: One of the few permanent human settlements in Raugrin on Ikoria, built beneath a volcanic shelf in the Ongra Range and defended by lava.

entities.name: Ongra Range
entities.description: Mountains of frequent eruptions where Lavabrink lies.

entities.name: Kauld
entities.description: Lava lake in the Ongra Mountains into which Lavabrink's lava flows.

entities.name: Jar Korcha
entities.description: Central road linking Lavabrink to distant parts of Ikoria.

entities.name: Stonesingers
entities.description: Mages of Lavabrink who manipulate lava flow with geomantic magic.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Lavabrink became a haven.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: City attacked and overwhelmed by Lukka and Phyrexian forces.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: Led forces that attacked Drannith alongside the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Drannith is attacked and overwhelmed by Lukka and Phyrexian forces; survivors flee west.
Lavabrink becomes a haven and focal point of resistance against the invaders.
